name: Marija Kovačić
bio:
Marija Kovačić's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. After years as a master auto body technician, her meticulous attention to detail caught the eye of a Ferrari scout during a local rally event. Impressed by her flawless paintwork and ability to match colors with unparalleled accuracy, she was offered a position at Ferrari AF Corse. 

Marija approaches her role with a blend of artistic flair and scientific precision. She insists on hand-mixing all custom colors, believing it allows for greater depth and vibrancy. Her dedication to perfection is legendary within the team; she often spends hours analyzing paint finishes under different lighting conditions to ensure a flawless result. What sets Marija apart is her ability to visualize the final aesthetic of a car even before the first coat of primer is applied. She possesses a rare gift for understanding how color and texture interact with a vehicle's form to create a truly stunning visual impact.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly styled shoulder-length hair, often pulled back into a practical bun while working.
physical.description: Marija is a woman of average height with a strong, determined gaze and hands that bear the marks of a life dedicated to craftsmanship.

quirks: Constantly hums traditional Croatian folk tunes while working.
Has an uncanny ability to predict the weather based on the feel of the air humidity, crucial for paint drying times.
Always carries a small, worn notebook filled with her custom color formulas and inspirational paint schemes.
